# `measure`

a field (stored, or a field chain composed in) reduced over the members of a selection (stored, or made by a maker), by registry measures, into one measurement.

Version 2, scope `subject`. Run it with `nxr-neuro run measure --dataset <folder> --subject <id> ...`; `nxr-neuro run measure --help` prints the same options.

Examples:

```
nxr-neuro run measure --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --field rest_psd_alpha --over "cortex tiles" --weight barycentric --measures '["mean","max"]'
nxr-neuro run measure --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --recording rest --set cortical_band_cells --band "8-16 Hz" --spatial-scale "wavelength 40 mm" --all
```

## Inputs

| input | what it is | required |
|---|---|---|
| `statistic` | statistic any, where {"name": "$statistic"}, when $statistic (a stored STATISTIC by name (--statistic): its first axis (the channels of a PSD) is reduced over the members of `over`) | yes |
| `field` | field any, each true, where {"name": "$field"}, chain $chain, chain_parameters $chain_parameters, when !$statistic (a stored field by name (--field), OR a field chain composed in (--chain)) | yes |
| `over` | selection any, where {"name": "$over"}, make $make (a stored selection by name (--over), OR one made in the run by a maker (--make)) | yes |
| `weights` | field any, required false, where {"name": "$weights"}, when !$statistic | no |
| `line` | manifold line, is field.time, required false, when !$statistic (the field's time line (what a maker of the run's span reads: a `before` node reads arrays, never the streamed field)) | no |
| `space` | manifold any, is field.manifold.0, required false, when !$statistic (the field's first manifold (what a maker of its elements reads: the channels, the vertices)) | no |
| `statistic_space` | manifold any, is statistic.manifold.0, required false, when $statistic (the manifold the statistic's first axis runs along (what a maker of its elements reads: a PSD's channels)) | no |
| `pick` | statistic any, where {"name": "$channels"}, required false, when $statistic (a stored statistic whose channel axis is a pick (a cross-spectrum): the members hold only those channels) | no |
| `tiles` | selection ladder, manifold field.manifold.0, when $spatial_scale (the surface's grid whose level the spatial scale is (`nxr-neuro run select_dyadic_surface` first); absent without a spatial scale) | yes |
| `bad` | selection spans, manifold field.time, where {"name": "{field}_bad_segments"}, required false, when !$statistic | no |

## Parameters

Each is an option `--<name> VALUE` (dashes for underscores; the value is read as YAML) or `--set NAME=VALUE`.

| parameter | option | default | unit | choices | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `statistic` | `--statistic` | none | - |  | a stored statistic, by name (a PSD [channels x frequencies]): its first axis is reduced over the members of `over`, and the measurement is OF the statistic: the rows are its other axes (the frequencies). Instead of field / chain |
| `field` | `--field` | none | - |  | a stored field, by name (a scalar or hermitian3 map on a surface; `nxr-neuro run surface_frames` first for hermitian3 and gradients) |
| `chain` | `--chain` | none | - |  | a field chain composed in: band_analytic \| cortical_band \| member_activation \| band_outer (exactly one of field, chain) |
| `chain_parameters` | `--chain-parameters` | none | - |  | the chain's parameters, as quantities (bands, spatial_scale, shape, ...) |
| `over` | `--over` | none | - |  | a stored selection by name: any of the five types, any family (exactly one of over, make) |
| `make` | `--make` | none | - |  | a maker composed in: {node: select.*, ...} with its parameters as quantities |
| `recording` | `--recording` | `none` | - |  | the recording's name when the field is a chain over a recording, or none: every recording of the subject, one run each |
| `measures` | `--measures` | none | - |  | the measures per member, from the registry (no default: the caller's or the preset's): mean, sum, mean_square, max, min, abs_max, count, median (weight none only), amplitude, envelope_max, power, phase_current, outflow, circulation, levi_civita, tensor_*, gradient_*, and the members' own area, n_elements, duration, centre, path_length |
| `weight` | `--weight` | none | - | none, barycentric, voronoi | how the elements of a member are weighted: none \| barycentric \| voronoi (it changes the numbers, so it is always stated) |
| `weights` | `--weights` | none | - |  | a stored per-element weight field by name (area, mass), when `weight` is given |
| `bad_segments` | `--bad-segments` | `exclude` | - | exclude, ignore | exclude = a sample in one of the recording's bad segments carries no value and no count \| ignore = every sample counts |
| `band` | `--band` | none | Hz |  | ONE temporal band as a quantity ("8-16 Hz") for the presets that make a chain and a time grid of it (a band SET stays a selection, `over`) |
| `spatial_scale` | `--spatial-scale` | none | mm |  | the spatial band as a quantity (a tile diameter, `wavelength 40 mm`, `parts 16`, an eigenvalue): the level of the surface's grid the presets couple to |
| `channels` | `--channels` | none | - |  | a stored cross-spectrum's name: the presets that read the sensors' analytic signal use ITS channels only; null: every channel |
| `duration` | `--duration` | none | s |  | the time tiles of the presets that tile the run: a duration as a quantity ("1 s"), snapped to 2^k samples |
| `form` | `--form` | none | - | None, magnitude, power, phase_current | the pointwise form read before the reduction, for a complex or vector field (the registry's form of the measures asked: magnitude for amplitude / envelope_max, power for power, phase_current for the current's measures); null: the field is reduced as it is (a real quantity) |
| `rolled_to` | `--rolled-to` | none | mm |  | roll the measurement up to a coarser level of its grid, stated as a quantity (a tile diameter, a duration, pieces, whole), merged by each measure's rule; null: stored at the grid's own level |
| `summaries` | `--summaries` | none | - |  | also summarise across the members: mean, sd, median, mad, percentile:P, min, max, skewness, kurtosis, peak, count; null: none |
| `combine` | `--combine` | `each` | - | each, pool, mean | summaries: each = per row \| pool = the rows pooled \| mean = the mean of the rows' summaries |
| `name` | `--name` | none | - |  | the stored measurement's name; null: derived from the field and the selection |

## The chain of nodes

| phase | node | in | with | out |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| chunks over `field` | [`signal.field_form`](../nodes.md) | x=field | form=$form | shaped |
| chunks over `field` | [`measurement.reduce`](../nodes.md) | x=shaped, over=over, exclude=bad, weights=weights | measures=$measures, weight=$weight, bad_segments=$bad_segments | values, ingredients |
| chunks over `field` | [`measurement.reduce`](../nodes.md) | x=field, over=over, exclude=bad, weights=weights | measures=$measures, weight=$weight, bad_segments=$bad_segments | values, ingredients |
| after | [`measurement.reduce_statistic`](../nodes.md) | x=statistic, over=over | measures=$measures | statistic_values |
| after | [`measurement.roll_up`](../nodes.md) | x=ingredients | to=$rolled_to | rolled, rolled_ingredients |
| after | [`measurement.summarize`](../nodes.md) | x=values | summaries=$summaries, combine=$combine | statistics |

`before` steps run once, `chunks` steps run on every chunk of the recording, `after` steps run once on what the chunks accumulated.

## Outputs

| output | stored as |
|---|---|
| `values` | kind measurement, over over, of field, name $name, when !$statistic |
| `statistic_values` | kind measurement, over over, of_statistic statistic, name $name, when $statistic |
| `rolled` | kind measurement, over over, of field, when $rolled_to |
| `statistics` | kind statistic, of values, when $summaries |

## Notes from the definition

```text
THE ONE MEASURING DEFINITION (version 2): a FIELD (a stored one by name, OR a field chain composed in) REDUCED over the members of a SELECTION (a stored one by name, OR made in the run by a maker), by the measures of
the registry, into one MEASUREMENT over the members (the table `selection_measurement`, array-backed). The four operations are one implementation each (spec docs/specs/2026-11-17-consolidation.md section 2): `reduce`
(this definition), `roll_up` (the step `after`, when `to` is given, and the definition `roll_up`), `summarize` (when `summaries` is given, and the definition `summarize`), `estimate` (the Welch family).

THE FIELD. Exactly one of `field` / `chain`: a stored field by name, or a field chain (`band_analytic`, `cortical_band`, `member_activation`, `band_outer`) composed into the run (nothing stored, its name and resolved
parameters in the cache key).
A STORED STATISTIC instead (`statistic`, schema 54): its first axis (the channels of a PSD) reduced over the members of `over`, the measurement OF the statistic (rows = its other axes, the frequencies); `channels`
names a stored cross-spectrum whose channel pick makes the members. Preset `psd_channel_mean`; nothing is streamed. THE SELECTION. Exactly one of `over` / `make`: a stored selection by name, or a maker (`select.dyadic_surface`, `select.time_grid`, `select.bands`, `select.product`, `select.events.*`)
composed in; a maker composed in stores its selection get-or-create. Both given, or neither, is refused with the reason.

THE FORM of the field each measure reads (magnitude, power, phase_current, outer, none) is the pointwise node `field.form`, inserted from the measures registry (`io/schema/measures.json`: the form, the ingredient, the
merge rule). The measures are additive INGREDIENTS (count, weight, sum, sum_sq, max, min, abs_max): ratios (amplitude = sum / weight, sd, speed, travelling index) are derived at read, never reduced.
THE WEIGHT is stated, never assumed: none (1 a vertex), barycentric (a third of each incident triangle), voronoi (the mixed Voronoi area of the mollified input). On a real cortex they differ by tens of percent.
THE BAD SEGMENTS: members lose samples, never a factor. A band SET with a coupled product makes one product and one measurement per band member, in one pass; several (band x spatial scale) pairs are several plans of
one run (each cached on its own).

PRESETS are ONLY named parameter sets (below). Provenance records the preset's name; the CACHE KEY holds only the resolved parameters, so two presets with equal parameters are one cached result.

  nxr-neuro run measure --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --field rest_psd_alpha --over "cortex tiles" --weight barycentric --measures '["mean","max"]'
  nxr-neuro run measure --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --recording rest --set cortical_band_cells --band "8-16 Hz" --spatial-scale "wavelength 40 mm" --all
```
